verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (brand, headline, large product), but the CTA 'Find It Near You' has shrunk to a tiny pill the same size as the badges, which buries the action. The body copy is pushed to the bottom below the buttons, so the reading order is reversed, and there are large dead gaps above and below the button row. B is scattered on two columns with no clear logic: the product is shrunk into the top-right corner, the headline floats on the left with no link to the content beside it, the CTA and badges float far apart in the right column, the body copy wraps in a narrow column at the bottom right, and the big empty areas leave the layout looking unintentional.
